name: Museum of Modern Art
tagline: Van Gogh's Starry Night, Picasso's Demoiselles, Dalí's Persistence of Memory.
description: Founded in 1929 as the first museum dedicated to modernism. Collection includes the most-photographed painting in the building (Starry Night), the most-debated (Les Demoiselles d'Avignon), and the entire arc of 20th-century art on six floors.
review_long:
MoMA's permanent collection on the fifth floor is one of the densest concentrations of canonical modern paintings anywhere — Starry Night, The Persistence of Memory, Demoiselles d'Avignon, Number 31 by Pollock, all within a few rooms of each other. The temporary exhibitions on the lower floors are worth as much time as the permanent collection.

Fridays after 4 PM are free for everyone but extremely crowded; weekday mornings are the best time to see the masterpieces without a phone in front of every one of them.

tips.text: Free Fridays are packed — go a weekday morning if you can.
